verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is API-first: simple URL-based endpoint plus a rich set of documented HTTP headers (x-respond-with, x-preset, x-json-schema, x-markdown-chunking, x-proxy, etc.) enabling programmatic, agent-friendly control over output format, chunking, and scraping behavior. Some community reports note auth/404 issues, but the core documented API surface for AI-native use is extensive and well-specified.
